description: Acceptance manifest: the CANONICAL requirement set per PR — the source of the criteria + required-gates the WP-12B validator reconciles a review against, supplied as TrustedInputs, NOT taken from the review artifact. A reviewer cannot invent, drop, or renumber criteria: the set here must be enumerated completely. Criterion text is mirrored from the ratified spec section named in `spec`. STATUS is owner-review-pending: this is the builder's PROPOSED bar; it becomes the ratified bar when the owner approves this PR's protected-surface change (it lives under assurance/contract/ in protected-surface.txt, so a builder cannot later edit it without owner review). `required_gates` are logical keys the CI merge-gate binds to REAL check conclusions (github needs.*.result); the validator requires each to be a real 'success' for APPROVE.

criteria.text: review_contract.json exists and is loadable; valid_verdicts matches review-gate.md exactly (a test asserts no drift).

WP-12B rejects the real PRIV-001 LAND-WITH-NITS fixture AND a synthetic APPROVE-with-unmet-criterion; accepts a well-formed CHANGES-REQUIRED and APPROVE. Hardened: fabricated self-attested APPROVE (equal fake SHAs, invented criterion, empty evidence, required-gate skip) is rejected; APPROVE without external truth fails closed.

WP-12C scanner is RED on injected raw egress across every bypass class (direct, callable-alias, intermediate-variable, .stream/.parse terminals, direct provider HTTP); GREEN on the clean tree; identity is unique per call site (duplicate calls and same-named methods in different classes do not collapse).
Incident ESC-2026-08-13-priv001-spec-conformance links the WP-12B replay test and records correct #326 provenance; status is not CLOSED while the gate is unmerged/unenforced.

New gate files present in protected-surface.txt (incl. the WP-12 spec, incident registry, review-gate.md, and test_protected_surface_sync.py); CODEOWNERS regenerated in the same commit; protected-surface sync test green.
An executable CI check runs the validator (self-test proves it is non-vacuous every run) and validates committed structured review artifacts; the Markdown PR table is not the artifact of record.
Independent review against this section's criteria (dogfooded via the WP-12B contract). MERGE-BLOCKING and owner/independent-only — the builder cannot mark this met.
